propositions: Prior plan-review findings with empty evidence lists are re-injected on every subsequent review even after the plan is edited to address them, creating a permanent ratchet that blocks convergence.
Recalled findings lose their persisted evidence during injection (hardcoded to empty list), so Pass-2 verification cannot ground the claim against current plan text and rubber-stamps bare assertions.

The recall eligibility filter checks only decision and priority, not whether material has changed; findings persist across material edits and re-qualify for recall indistinguishably from fresh findings.
Pass-2 absence veto fails to fire because injected candidates carry no evidence, so the verifier confirms empty assertions rather than searching the plan for refuting provisions.
The fix carries persisted evidence into prior concerns, excludes evidence-less priors from recall, and suppresses recall when material fingerprints differ between prior and current sidecars.
